description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked on top of column 0 (leftmost) with the cell above empty, i.e. a vertical must-block in column 0; this gives very strong activation. Weaker firing when exactly two of their stones sit on rows 2-3 of column 0 (column height 4). Same patterns in other columns, horizontal/diagonal threats into column 0, my own stack, or a full column do not fire it.
effect: When forced high it raises the move in column 0 (blocking the vertical threat), e.g. column 0 from 0.07 to 0.34 in a two-stack position; zeroing it in a dev must-block position lowers column 0 from 1.00 to 0.71. Often redundant: when the block is already certain, steering changes nothing.
notes: p1 (their 3-stack in col0 only): F1 0.49, P 0.995. p2 (+low 2-stacks, my 3-stacks): F1 0.34, rejected. p3 (+their 2-stack on rows 2-3 at height 4): F1 0.682, P 0.90, R 0.55, AUROC 0.77, simulation share 1.53 of ceiling. Minimal pairs: same stack in cols 1/3/6 ~0; last move need not be in col0; full column kills it. Remaining ~45% of firing is weak (0.5-2.5) and diffuse with no clear pattern. Synthesis 6,3,0,0,6,0,4,0 = 17.2 beats dev max 16.75.
